subject: textbox "Member Number" within "Member Number Search"
reason: policy heritage-core-default permits fill (risky) on http://127.0.0.1:62871 — Every field this deployment's capabilities fill is a search field on a query form — member number, account number — and filling one commits nothing on its own. It is classified risky because a value typed into the wrong box is how a transfer acquires the wrong payee, and because the values are member data. The control that keeps that from happening is the Target robustness argument recorded against each fill in its Capability Artifact, which a reviewer approves before the artifact runs.

subject: button "Find"
reason: policy heritage-core-default permits click (risky) on http://127.0.0.1:62871 — Clicking is how a search is submitted and how an account is opened from a member's list, and there is no way to read a balance out of Heritage Core without doing both. It is the action that actually commits, so the capabilities approved for unattended replay are read-only ones: nothing in artifacts/ presses a control that posts a transaction. That is a property of the approved artifacts rather than of this line, which is why the artifacts are reviewed and versioned.

subject: link "Regular Savings" within "Share and Deposit Accounts"
reason: policy heritage-core-default permits selectFromList (risky) on http://127.0.0.1:62871 — A selection reads the items a screen is currently offering and presses the one whose label matches the parameter, so it commits exactly what a click commits and is classified the same way. It is permitted because the alternative is recording one artifact per account type, which multiplies the number of documents a reviewer has to approve without reducing what any of them can do. What bounds it is that the match is a token subset of a label the screen itself offered, never a free-text instruction: a selection cannot reach a control the list does not contain, and an ambiguous match stops the run rather than choosing.

target: link "Regular Savings" within "Share and Deposit Accounts"
rationale: scoped to the table headed "Share and Deposit Accounts"; 2 link(s) on offer: "Regular Savings", "Share Draft"; every token of "Savings" is in "Regular Savings"; then scoped to the table headed "Share and Deposit Accounts"; 2 node(s) with role link; 1 named exactly "Regular Savings"
